data.overview: In the mid-2000s, a popular television sting show drew millions to watch men arrive expecting secret meetings with minors, only to face a polished host and waiting police. Years later, the filmmakers examine the program's methods, audience, and legacy.
data.tagline: The spectacle kept the cameras rolling.
